answer.says: You are right, Sunil. I over-extended the metaphor. The milk is not inorganic; it is simply a medium. I shall drink the fuel and eat the samosa, and leave the system of wants to the grocer.
answer.thought: The correction is just. I projected my dialectic onto his trade, and he corrected me with the authority of the practitioner. The samosa is hot; the hunger is a physical demand that must be met before I can return to the abstract. I will eat quickly.
